QuestInfo.name: Edelstein and the Resistance
QuestInfo.0: #bNeinheart#k says the next mission is a dispatch mission to #bEdelstein#k. Listen to the details.
QuestInfo.1: #bNeinheart#k wants to ask you something before sending you to Edelstein.
QuestInfo.2: #bNeinheart#k says that the #bResistance#k in Edelstein are not allies of the Cygnus Knights. It's a little odd that two organizations with common enemies aren't allies, but you shouldn't jump to conclusions just yet.

0.0: I am sending you to #bEdelstein#k to infiltrate the Black Wings and gather information. Are you up to the task?

yes.0: I like your enthusiasm, but I have a few things to explain before you go. \r\nSpeak to me again in a moment.

1.0: The Black Wings may hold Edelstein, but there is an underground organization that works against them. \r\n#L0##bExcellent! Who are those brave men and women?#l\n#k
1.1: They call themselves the #bResistance#k.\r\n#L0##bThey sound like powerful allies!#l\n#k
1.2: Unfortunately, that is not quite the case. In fact, that is what I wanted to warn you about. They may not give you the warmest of welcomes...\r\n#L0##bWhy's that?#l\n#k
1.3: You'll find out, little by little. I don't have time to explain it right now, but do not expect any aid from them, even though we share a common enemy... Do you understand?

yes.0: Very good, then I will give you your mission.
